items.name: Emergency Services — 999
items.description: Call 999 for Police, Fire or Ambulance in any life-threatening emergency. This is the UK's main emergency number — free to call from any phone.

items.name: Police Non-Emergency — 101
items.description: Call 101 for non-emergency police matters — lost property, minor incidents, reporting suspicious activity. Not for life-threatening situations.

items.name: NHS Medical Helpline — 111
items.description: Call 111 for urgent medical advice that is not life-threatening. Available 24/7. Also available online at 111.nhs.uk for non-urgent queries.

items.name: University College Hospital
items.description: One of London's major NHS teaching hospitals with a 24/7 Accident & Emergency department. Nearest A&E to Central London.

items.name: Common Tourist Scams
items.description: Watch out for: fake street sellers, petition scammers near tourist spots, overcharging taxis, fake TfL staff asking for payment. Always use licensed black cabs or Uber.

items.name: British Transport Police
items.area: All London stations and the Tube
items.description: Report crime on public transport, trains and the London Underground. Text 61016 or call 0800 40 50 40. Look for officers on platforms and concourses.
items.address: All London train stations and Underground

items.name: St Thomas' Hospital
items.description: Major NHS hospital with 24-hour A&E, directly across the river from Big Ben. One of London's busiest emergency departments.

items.name: The Royal London Hospital
items.description: One of the largest hospitals in the UK with a major trauma centre and 24-hour A&E department.

items.name: University College Hospital
items.description: Central London teaching hospital with A&E department, easily accessible near Euston and King's Cross.

items.name: West End Central Police Station
items.description: Main police station covering the West End tourist areas including Soho, Oxford Street and Piccadilly.

items.name: Charing Cross Police Station
items.description: Central police station covering Trafalgar Square, Covent Garden and the Strand area.

items.name: Fake Ticket Sellers Warning
items.description: Never buy attraction or show tickets from street sellers near landmarks. Always book directly through official websites — street tickets are often fake or overpriced.

items.name: Fake Charity Collectors
items.description: Be cautious of people with clipboards asking for donations or signatures near tourist spots — some are scams designed to distract you while pickpocketing.

items.name: Unlicensed Taxi Overcharging
items.description: Only use licensed black cabs or pre-booked minicabs/Uber. Unlicensed taxis at airports and tourist spots often massively overcharge tourists.

items.name: Samaritans
items.description: Free confidential emotional support helpline, available 24/7 for anyone struggling or in crisis.

items.name: Visit London Tourist Information
items.description: Official London tourism helpline for general visitor information, attractions and travel advice.
